summary: Filter redundant findings that substantially overlap with decision summaries in formatForLLM
context: When an agent records both a finding and a decision about the same thing (e.g., off-by-one bug), both appeared in the output, wasting token budget and diluting signal.
rationale: Substring overlap check (first 30 chars of lowercase summary) catches the common case where a finding is promoted to a decision. Non-overlapping findings are preserved. This is conservative — only filters obvious duplicates.
